name: The New India Assurance Company Ltd
title: The New India Assurance Company Ltd - 540769 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Insurer's FY26 combined ratio hit 122.57% on wage-revision charges (116.67% ex-wage), with motor TP and OD ICRs worsening; management guides motor to single-digit growth and better ratios, but commentary on pricing is competitive and unhedged on rate relief.

triggers.label: Motor TP ICR 108.17% → 113.86%
triggers.quote: Motor TP also saw a worsening of the ICR from 108.17% to 113.86%.

triggers.label: Q4 fire premium degrowth -4.33%
triggers.quote: Q4 saw a reduction of 4.33% degrowth. The reason for this being that the market was highly competitive, the rates literally crashing in the property market.

triggers.label: Motor growth single digit, combined ratio to fall
triggers.quote: On Motor, I think it will be a single digit growth. We will not be very aggressive on Motor.

triggers.label: Motor discounts rising every quarter
triggers.quote: No, it has gone up. It has been increasingly going up over every quarter in the last year.

guidance.quote: On Motor, I think it will be a single digit growth. We will not be very aggressive on Motor.
It would be a single digit for Motor, double digit for the entire book.
I think the overall ratios will also show a reducing trend in the current fiscal.

red_flags.label: Combined ratio 122.57% incl. wage revision
red_flags.quote: The combined ratio was reported at 122.57%.

red_flags.label: Motor TP premium rate stagnant, awards rising
red_flags.quote: The reason being that the much-awaited premium increase has still not happened, which we are awaiting for.

red_flags.label: Rising motor discounts
red_flags.quote: It has been increasingly going up over every quarter in the last year.

evasions.quote: It will also be linked with our strategies fo r this portfolio recalibration.
when you talk about growth, it's also in context with the environment.
